Type: wingback leather swivel office chair
Use: working at a desk; home office, study
Style: traditional, classic, contemporary
Materials: smooth leather upholstery, nailhead trim, dark stained wood star base, black metal column, casters
Colors: charcoal black, dark mahogany wood, antique brass
Shape: high wingback with rolled flared arms, nailhead-trimmed sides, plump seat, five-star wooden base on casters, solid and generous
Feel: refined, grounded, sophisticated
Goes with: dark wood desks, brass lamps, grey or white walls, leather-bound books; traditional or transitional offices

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Benton Leather Swivel Office Chair with Wheels, 28.4"W, Black
product.description: Top-grain leather and bold, eclectic armrests make this swivel office chair a style stand-out. The two-paneled back, firm cushioning and elastic webbing make it durable and comfortable, while the leather shows unique natural markings. 28.4"W x 24.2"D x 41"H Top-grain leather upholstery; wood and metal swivel base; five metal wheels. 360 degree swivel. Sturdy for up to 250 lb capacity. Top-grain leather shows unique markings. Easy assembly in 15 minutes. Wipe with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
